title: Initiative
description: An INITIATIVE is a strategic theme that contains multiple campaigns. It defines the audience, the outcome goals, and the time horizon. Campaigns are individual ship events that advance the initiative. Initiatives are the parent of campaigns in the social-distribution hierarchy.

id.description: Slug (lowercase, dashes). Stable identifier across all campaigns.

title.description: Short human-readable name (≤ 80 chars). Example: 'Cyborg Series — Co-Intelligence Manifesto'.

tagline.description: One-sentence strategic thesis. Example: 'AI is not replacing humans; it's giving us a new operating system.'

primary.description: Who this initiative is for (one sentence).

exclude.description: Explicitly NOT for (e.g., 'not for B2C consumers').

metric.description: What is being measured. Example: 'LinkedIn followers'.

channels.description: Which hub / honey-pot / spokes this initiative will use (overrides defaults from brand-spec.json).

campaigns.description: Ordered list of campaigns under this initiative. Each entry references a campaign.json by id.

kpis_rollup.description: Aggregated metrics across all campaigns under this initiative (populated by distribution-analytics-engine).

notes.description: Free-text strategic notes. Decisions made, pivots, learnings.
